move: finger lands and swipes across, after glides in behind it, swipes back
how: A card rises in from y:60 with expo.out; the after layer is clipped with clip-path inset(0 (100-p)% 0 0) and an edge line follows p across the card width via onUpdate apply(). A hint drops in and a Before label slides in. At 0.18D a hand cursor lands from below with power3.out, then at 0.3D swipes x:-320→420 with expo.inOut over 1.3s while p goes 0→100, and the hand lifts away; the After label slides in and a caption rises from a mask. The photo breathes from scale 1.08 to 1.0. At 0.86D p glides back to 0 with expo.inOut, caption and After label exit and the Before label returns.
adapt: Swap the image (both layers use it with different filters; the CSS face/hair overlays can go), the labels, hint and caption; keep the 1.3s expo.inOut swipe and the 0.6s swipe-back.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .hint and .card with .before, .after, .edge, labels, .cap and .hand, defining apply() against el's .after and card.clientWidth; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the s proxy tweens (onUpdate apply) at 1.5/5 and 4.3/5 of D. Scope the document.querySelector calls to el.
caveats: uses document.querySelector for .after and .card; must be scoped
clip-path written via style in onUpdate
hand x values assume a 1080-wide card
